_note: Authoritative host + toolchain + clock reference for the sm_86 RTX 3090 Ti live-capture campaign. Sourced from CLAUDE.md (re-founded 2026-07-02), the live host, and the v2.1 protocol block of eval/frozen_labels/sm86_m1_bundle_v21.json. These are provenance/environment pins ONLY; no NCU metric value is a pin (Rule 1 governs metric values, not toolchain versions).

toolchain._nvcc_note: CLAUDE.md and the live host both report nvcc release 13.3 (/opt/cuda) atop the CUDA 13.2 toolkit (/usr/local/cuda-13.2). The founding-plan prose that reads 'nvcc 13.2' conflates the toolkit version with the compiler release; the compiler release is the pin.

reference_clock_state._note: The v2.1 reference config (clock=none x cache=all) is captured with the host clocks locked here via nvidia-smi -pm 1; -lgc 1350; -lmc 10501.

injection_runtime._smoke_note: The injection preflight runs this smallest deterministic elementwise portable_lcd binary at its correctness shape under the pinned runtime and requires a nonzero contract-valid trace (dynamic_trace.pb + stats.csv, validate_trace_dir ok, admitted records > 0). ldd-resolution alone is insufficient: CUDA_INJECTION64_PATH fails SILENTLY on an unresolved dep and the app then runs untraced. The smoke reads only instruction-admission counters and trace contract validity — no NCU metric value (Rule 1).
